scenario: LFCA.5 / LDIA.3.4.2 — with `series: false` a `series` declaration is DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED at the declaration. The program overrides `default`; `persist_on_series` is set false too, because LCAP.3.8 makes it require `series` and leaving it true would be refused first as DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_CONSTRAINT. Drives `dsc.dialect`'s per-construct gate (`series_sites`) on the refused side; the program has no other construct the settings forbid.
rules_ds:
use default:
    series: false
    persist_on_series: false

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable

series Sensor.val:
    mean sliding 10_min
